MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 931 May 13, 1976
APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE MANILA URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECT
WHEREAS, it is the commitment of the government to establish, maintain and ensure adequate social
services in the field of urban development and squatter relocation to guarantee the enjoyment by the people of
a decent standard of living; and to assign priority to blighted urban areas in order to alleviate the problems
arising from rapid population growth, high unemployment, widespread poverty, malnutrition and inadequate
shelter and urban services thru a program of upgrading blighted areas, provision of employment opportunities,
improvement of urban services and enhancement of operating capabilities of national and local agencies
WHEREAS, in line with these objectives, the government has embarked on an urban development program in
Metropolitan Manila involving the upgrading of sites and services in the Tondo Foreshore and the
development of the Dagat-Dagatan resettlement area, particularly the provision of improved environmental
sanitation, infrastructure and social services such as roads and pathways, drainage system, water and sewerage
system, public buildings, programs for the socio-economic development of the people, housing materials and
small business loans and traffic engineering and management;
WHEREAS, the government has sought financial assistance from the World Bank in the form of loans
amounting to about US$ 32M.
WHEREAS, there is a need to appropriate counterpart funds to cover the cost of the project;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the
Constitution as President of the Philippines, do hereby decree and authorize:
1. The appropriation of the sum of P598.10 million out of funds not otherwise appropriated in the National
Treasury for the following components of the Manila Urban Development Project to be made available to
appropriate agencies concerned in the four-year period of implementation of the project as indicated:
(a)Tondo Foreshore upgrading of sites and services including the provision of land and reclamation, civil
works, community facilities, housing materials, small business loans, incremental cost of developing the area
resulting from the construction of the C-2, R-10 and the expansion of Port of Manila, and other related
facilities to be undertaken by the National Housing AuthorityP243.10 M
(b)Construction and/or improvement of Tondo sewer outfall15.00 M
(c)Dagat-Dagatan resettlement including the provision of land infrastructure, community services and other
related facilities to be undertaken by the National Housing Authority65.00 M
(d)For the construction of major roads including bridges125.00 M
(e)Traffic improvements including junctions improvements, road markings, path poles, bus shelters, traffic
signal facilities, mobile radius and other facilities70.00 M
(f)Technical assistance, studies and training to (a) NHA for project development of a second urban project (b)
DPWTC for Metro Manila land use and transportation study and financing and delivery of public
(g)Technical assistance of DPWTC for transport planning, coordination and operations, undertaking of
national transport system study and revision of the 4-year infrastructure program20.00 M
2. The total amounts indicated above shall be made available for the corresponding project component thru the
implementing agencies over the duration of project implementation as indicated in the accompanying
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of May in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
